textLines.original: reservation times. Your server will advise you of when the next reservation is.
textLines.translated: 您的服务员会告知下一次预订的时间。

textLines.original: Reservations will be held for 5 minutes and all members must be present to be seated.
textLines.translated: 预订将保留5分钟，所有成员必须到齐方可就座。
